what: non-Gu treasures: heaven-and-earth materials, Immortal materials, formations, resource points and items

split_rule: Rows are ordered by sha1 of "artifacts-v1:<id>" and the first quarter (first hex byte below 0x40) are the tuning sample, the only rows the prompt or normaliser was adjusted on; every other row is held out and reported (GKM429). score.label: the wiki category kind (material, immortal-material, formation, resource-point, item, phenomenon; first match; hidden). Weak: the page rarely hides what it is
